name: Taskbar
author: joshjal
description: One icon per open window on this monitor, with a live hover preview

barWidget.description: One icon per open window on this monitor, with a live hover preview

schema.label: Icon size
schema.description: Icon size at rest. Icons shrink toward the minimum as more windows open on the monitor.

schema.label: Minimum icon size
schema.description: Floor for the automatic shrink, so a busy monitor never collapses the icons entirely.

schema.label: Maximum icons
schema.description: Windows past this count collapse into a "+N" overflow chip. 0 means unlimited.

schema.label: Include special workspaces
schema.description: Also show windows parked on special workspaces, such as the scratchpad. They carry a dot badge, sort last, show on every bar, and a left click brings one back to the workspace you are looking at.

schema.label: Show windows from every monitor
schema.description: Off, each monitor's taskbar lists only its own windows. On, every taskbar lists every window, so the same window appears on all of them.

schema.label: Order: workspace or creation
schema.description: "workspace" groups icons by workspace, then by when each window appeared. "creation" orders purely by age, so icons keep their slot when a window changes workspace.

schema.label: Show window titles
schema.description: Draw the window title beside each icon. Ignored on vertical bars, which have no width to spend on it.

schema.label: Max title width (px)
schema.description: Titles longer than this are elided. Only applies when titles are shown.

schema.label: Dim unfocused windows
schema.description: Unfocused windows render at half opacity. Turn off to render every icon at full strength.

schema.label: Middle click: close, bring, focus or none
schema.description: What middle-clicking an icon does. "bring" pulls the window onto the workspace you are looking at.

schema.label: Right click: menu, close, bring, focus or none
schema.description: What right-clicking an icon does. "menu" opens the context menu (close, move to workspace, toggle floating, move to monitor).

schema.label: Hover preview delay (ms)
schema.description: How long to hover before the live preview opens. Set to -1 to turn previews off entirely.

schema.label: Preview width (px)
schema.description: Width of the live hover preview.

schema.label: Preview max height (px)
schema.description: Height cap for the live hover preview; the thumbnail keeps the window's aspect ratio.
